query: UPDATE ops.tasks SET title=$3,status=$4,priority=$5, assignee_user_id=COALESCE($6,assignee_user_id),assigned_by=$7, assignment_reason=COALESCE($8,assignment_reason), completed_at=CASE WHEN $4='DONE' THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END WHERE task_type=$1 AND object_type=$1 AND object_id=$2 AND status<>'CANCELLED'
